intent_caption: Pick up the transparent plastic container and open its lid
subtasks: I will reach for the transparent plastic container.
I will grasp the container with my right arm.
I will grasp the lid with my left arm.
I will pull the lid off the container.
final_summary: I reached for the transparent plastic container but accidentally knocked it over with my left arm. I quickly recovered by picking it back up with my right arm, grasped the lid with my left arm, and successfully pulled it open.
